subject: ela
intro: Determine multiple central ideas and summarize objectively.

items.prompt:
A complex informational text often carries:
A) two or more interacting central ideas
B) no ideas
C) only a title
items.answer: A) two or more interacting central ideas

solution.answer: A) two or more interacting central ideas

items.prompt:
An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) states key ideas without opinion
B) adds your judgment
C) is very long
items.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

solution.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

items.prompt:
Two central ideas in a text can:
A) interact and build on one another
B) never relate
C) only repeat the title
items.answer: A) interact and build on one another

solution.answer: A) interact and build on one another

items.prompt:
Read.

The car gave Americans freedom and mobility but reshaped cities around cars and worsened pollution.

Two central ideas are:
A) the car's freedom/mobility and its costs
B) only that cars are fast
C) only that cities are big
items.answer: A) the car's freedom/mobility and its costs

steps: Two interacting ideas. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) the car's freedom/mobility and its costs

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary of that passage?
A) Cars selfishly ruined our beautiful cities.
B) The automobile expanded freedom and mobility while reshaping cities and worsening pollution.
C) I love driving.
items.answer: B) The automobile expanded freedom and mobility while reshaping cities and worsening pollution.

solution.answer: B) The automobile expanded freedom and mobility while reshaping cities and worsening pollution.

items.prompt:
When two central ideas INTERACT, they:
A) reinforce or complicate one another to build a complex analysis
B) cancel out
C) have no effect
items.answer: A) reinforce or complicate one another to build a complex analysis

solution.answer: A) reinforce or complicate one another to build a complex analysis

items.prompt:
Read.

The Green Revolution's new crops fed billions, but its heavy irrigation and chemicals strained water supplies and soils.

Two interacting central ideas are BEST stated as:
A) The revolution's power to feed the world and the environmental cost of doing so.
B) Farming is hard.
C) Crops are green.
items.answer: A) The revolution's power to feed the world and the environmental cost of doing so.

steps: Two interacting ideas. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) The revolution's power to feed the world and the environmental cost of doing so.

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary of an article on global trade?
A) Trade lowered consumer prices.
B) Greedy corporations obviously destroyed hardworking communities.
C) Trade also eliminated some local jobs.
items.answer: B) Greedy corporations obviously destroyed hardworking communities.

solution.answer: B) Greedy corporations obviously destroyed hardworking communities.
